messages:
Sam: Heads-up: FinBank wants a presales packet for their POC. They asked specifically for: completed SIG/CAIQ, our DPA + whether we accept SCCs, the exact DSAR handling timeline, and a 60-day trial quote. Can someone pick this up?

Rina: I can take the CAIQ. They use the CSA v4 layout. Ill fill in answers for network controls, auth, and data-retention. Note: hosted offering stores short-term request logs by default; will flag that.

Toby: Ill do pricing. For 60 days we typically propose a reserved pool (1x p4d equiv) + metered overage. I'll prepare two proposals: "Lite POC" (single instance, limited tokens) and "Full POC" (burst + monitoring).

Sam: Important privacy nuance: FinBank requires EU processing only and a deletion SLA for test-data. We need legal to confirm SCC acceptance and subprocessors appendix. @Legal-bot can you confirm?

Legal-bot: We can sign the EU SCCs (modular clauses) and will provide subprocessors list in Appendix B. DPA template (redwood_dpa_v4.pdf) uploaded to #sales-assets. Redlines subject to standard review.

Rina: CAIQ rows to watch: CRYPTO (key mgmt) - hosted=partial (we use cloud KMS, no customer HSM); DATA.LIFECYCLE - partial (30d trace logs). For private/dedicated we can enable customer-managed KMS and HSM.

QA: FinBank also asked about pen test reports and compliance attestations. We have SOC2 Type II and annual external pentests. Ill attach cert links and last pen-test summary.

infra-ops: For the POC we can run with ephemeral logs. Config: set LOG_RETENTION=0 and ENABLE_EPHEMERAL=true on the tenant. Cache deletion requires calling admin endpoint. Example:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/admin/tenants/finbank/cache/invalidate
```
We estimate cache purge + audit logs cleared within 7 business days after request.

Sam: That timeline helps. Rina: can you mark the CAIQ answers and explicitly note which items are "requires ops action" vs "legal clause"? FinBank will ask about proof.

Rina: yes - I'll add a notes column: "ops-runbook needed" for cache and deletion, "legal DPA appendix" for subprocessors, "compliance docs" for SOC2/pen-test.

Toby: Pricing note: for an enterprise POC we recommend a refundable deposit plus committed weekly token allotment to avoid overage surprises. I'll put sample math on the slide. Any constraints on discounts?

Legal-bot: Trial discount approvals require approval from commercial lead. Submit discount request via sales-ops form.

Sam: Action list: Rina -> CAIQ + cert links; Toby -> 60-day pricing two-track slide; infra-ops -> runbook snippet + curl; QA -> attach SOC2 and pentest summary; Legal-bot -> DPA + subprocessors appendix draft. Ill package and send to FinBank tomorrow morning.

infra-ops: One more ops detail: KV/model-cache is tenant-scoped. To remove PII from model cache we must run invalidate and then rotate model namespaces if used for fine-tuning. Will document steps.

Rina: Also flag DSAR specifics: identity verification required, typical turnaround 5 business days for info requests, 10 business days for deletions (ops + audit). We'll surface both numbers.

Sam: Great. If nobody flags blockers by EOD Ill schedule a dry-run for the packet review at 9am tomorrow. :rocket:
